name: Rectified flow controlled forward/reverse
plain: Inverts then re-generates by blending the unconditional vector field with a straight-line field to a target, per RF-Inversion formula in comments. Forward goes to noise; reverse returns to a guide.
math:
Forward: v̂=u(Y,σ)+γ_i((y1−Y)/(1−t_i)−u), t_i=σ/σ_max, Y+=v̂(σᵢ₊₁−σᵢ).
Reverse: v̂=−u+η_i((y0−X)/(1−t_i)+u), t_i=i/N, X+=v̂(σᵢ−σᵢ₊₁).
label: from code
surprise: Forward and reverse use different t definitions; a comment says the i/N form is empirically better.
